summary: Formats the time gap (or lap-count gap) between the current object and a target for HUD/debug text. Seeds the output buffer a1 with asc_5CCE54, then bails out when the suppression flag at dword_7C54E0 + 16484 is set or the target (at dword_7C54E0 + 16592) is null/suppressed or LapTimeGapCalculation fails. When behind, fabs + SpatialGridCell convert the gap into minutes/seconds formatted as "-%.2d:%06.3f". When ahead, picks a unit label (off_5CCE74 for exactly 1 lap, otherwise aLaps_0), resolves it through BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC, and formats " -%d %s".

operations.description: strcpy(a1, asc_5CCE54): seed the output buffer a1 with the header string stored at 0x005CCE54.
Guard: if the flag at dword_7C54E0 + 16484 is non-zero (display suppression on the current object), return 0 immediately.
Read the target object pointer at dword_7C54E0 + 16592; if it is null, its suppression flag at +16484 is set, or LapTimeGapCalculation(target, current, &gap, &lapCount) fails, return 0.
Behind case: when the lap-count result <= 0, take fabs of the gap value, convert it with SpatialGridCell into minutes/seconds components, and format "-%.2d:%06.3f" into the buffer.
Ahead case: pick the unit label - off_5CCE74 when the lap count equals 1, otherwise aLaps_0.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, label, byte_5EC4CC) looks the label up in the sorted string table; on a match copy the label into byte_5EC4CC, otherwise clear byte_5EC4CC[0] to 0.
Format " -%d %s" with the lap count and byte_5EC4CC via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
